questions.question_text:
A wall in the shape of a parallelogram has a base of $18\text{ m}$ and a perpendicular height of $5\text{ m}$.
Each litre of paint covers $6\text{ m}^{2}$ and costs $\$16$.
Find the cost of painting the wall.

options.why: Multiplied the area $90\text{ m}^{2}$ by the price per litre without dividing by the coverage per litre.
Halved the parallelogram area using the triangle formula before calculating the paint cost.
Calculated $90\div6=15$ litres but did not multiply by the price per litre.

questions.solution_text:
$A=bh$
$=18\times5$
$=90\text{ m}^{2}$
Paint needed: $90\div6=15$ litres.
Cost: $15\times16=240$.
The paint costs $\$240$.
